# diff all

# version
# Betaflight / STM32F405 (S405) 4.5.1 Mar 19 2025 / 10:06:16 (77d01ba3b) MSP API: 1.46
# config rev: 1a2b3c4

# start the command batch
batch start

# reset configuration to default settings
defaults nosave

board_name SPEEDYBEEF405V4
manufacturer_id SPBE
mcu_id 0032003b3431511138363338
signature

# feature
feature GPS

# serial
serial 1 64 115200 57600 0 115200

# aux
aux 0 0 0 1800 2100 0 0
aux 1 1 1 1300 2100 0 0

# master
set gyro_lpf1_static_hz = 0
set dyn_notch_count = 1
set dshot_bidir = ON
set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT600
set yaw_deadband = 5

profile 0

# profile 0
set p_roll = 60
set d_roll = 50

profile 1

# profile 1
set profile_name = FREESTYLE
set p_pitch = 55
set d_pitch = 44
set p_roll = 52
set i_roll = 90
set d_roll = 35
set f_roll = 140
set p_yaw = 50
set f_yaw = 100
set d_min_roll = 25
set d_min_pitch = 32
set d_max_gain = 40

profile 2

profile 3

# restore original profile selection
profile 1

rateprofile 0

# rateprofile 0
set rates_type = BETAFLIGHT
set roll_rc_rate = 100
set pitch_rc_rate = 100
set yaw_rc_rate = 100
set roll_srate = 70
set pitch_srate = 70
set yaw_srate = 60

rateprofile 1

rateprofile 2

# rateprofile 2
set rateprofile_name = GSFPV
set thr_mid = 45
set thr_expo = 25
set roll_rc_rate = 20
set pitch_rc_rate = 20
set yaw_rc_rate = 18
set roll_expo = 30
set pitch_expo = 30
set roll_srate = 85
set pitch_srate = 85
set yaw_srate = 65

rateprofile 3

# restore original rateprofile selection
rateprofile 2

# save configuration
save
